A model passes every check in the doctor with a measure whose DAX is broken -- the file opens, the measure is listed in the Data pane, and the failure appears only on the page as 'Something's wrong with one or more fields', a card that takes every other field in that visual down with it. That is precisely the class this skill exists to catch before anyone authors anything, and the check is free: one EVALUATE against an already-open Desktop, needing neither Node nor the Bridge, i.e. it works at capability tier 3 where nothing else does. The addition was written at 172 tokens and compressed to 94 before the raise was taken; what is left is the query, the symptom string an author would search for, and the instruction not to report 'could not run' as a pass.
